lure: Someone claims to have filmed you through your webcam

message.subject: I filmed you - pay in 48 hours
message.body: I filmed you through your webcam. Pay $1,500 in Bitcoin in 48 hours or I send the video to everyone. Your old password is: [password]. Pay in bitcoin now.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: Nobody filmed you.
reasons: The old password quoted comes from a data breach.
The message is sent from your own address, a trick.
